tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder/Tenderer should provide standard good quality of food
Bidder/Tenderer should provide different variety of Tiffin daily as per enclosed BID Estimate
Payment will be made according to the financial conditions on availability of fund.
CMC holds the authority of Accepting and rejecting of tender
Bidder/Tenderer should Enclose local address proof
Bidder/Tenderer should Enclose Valid FSSAI Certificate
Bidder/Tenderer should Enclose Trade License Certificate 2026-27
Bidder/Tenderer should Enclose Annual Turnover Certificate of Previous 3 years
Bidder/Contractor must attach Similar nature of Work Done Certificate obtained form competent authority

itemList.itemName: Providing of daily morning breakfast to Pourakarmikas Chapati Bhaaji with 1 boiled egg,Rice Pulav with 1 boiled egg,Idli Sambar with 1 boiled egg,Puri Bhaji with 1 boiled egg,Shira Uppita Chou Chou Bath with 1 boiled egg, Avalakki with 1 boiled egg/Dose Bhaaji with 1 boiled egg among all these items providing one item on daily basis to the mentioned spot. Rs.35 per plate Item X 116 Nos Labours X 212 days Total Rs. 860720.00 Tenderer Should quote for only each Plate Item against Rs.35.00 only
